notes: Account overview: mid-market SaaS company offering in-app customer engagement and help center search. Product team wants to deliver faster, more relevant support answers and push conversation summarization to agents.
Initial engagement: started with Redwood Hosted API trial (2026-02-01). Self-serve signup, used small credit allocation to pilot chat + embeddings routes.
Trial metrics observed (key): avg QPS during weekday peak: 6-8 qps sustained (chat + embeddings mixed). Peak concurrency observed on trial: ~18 concurrent requests (bursty at 11:00 PDT).

Token mix from Hosted trial: ~60% embeddings calls (short, 256 tokens avg), 30% chat/generation (prompt 180 tokens avg, completion 240 tokens avg), 10% reranking/batch scoring (larger batched requests up to 2k tokens total).
Latency notes: Hosted API p50 generation 160-220ms, p95 650-900ms (observed during busy window), embeddings p50 40-70ms. Team is sensitive to p95 generation <400ms target for in-product UX.
Cost sensitivity: product team expects 2-3x scale vs trial within 6 months. Strong interest in lowering per-token cost; open to Dedicated if unit economics improve and latency SLOs tighten.

POC and demo history: 2026-02-18 demo (Carlos/CarlosVEGA) covered routing/fallbacks and batching. Fireflies transcript id attached. 2026-02-25 POC started with focused dataset: FAQ + chat conversion logs (60k queries/month in trial subset).

Dedicated sizing ask: customer requested capacity plan to handle projected steady-state 25 qps with 75 concurrent short inference windows and peaks up to 150 concurrent during promotions. Token mix estimate for sizing: 55% embeddings, 35% chat generation (avg 400 tokens total per generation), 10% reranking/batch scoring (larger tokens).

Redwood SE input so far: suggested baseline Dedicated cluster: 4x A100-class GPUs with autoscaling to 6 for peak, kv-cache warmers + prefix caching for common flows. Estimated effective throughput: ~20-30 qps for mixed workload per 4-GPU pool depending on quantization. Team requested explicit per-QPS cost calc (sheet linked).

Security & compliance path: submitted initial security questionnaire 2026-02-28. Infosec asked for SAML SP metadata, retention controls, and audit log samples. Customer wants EU residency option for EU customers (multi-region routing).

Procurement notes: AE provided preliminary pricing deck 2026-03-01. Legal is OK with standard terms but requires price floor for Dedicated commit and SLA language edits. Finance will target a 12-month committed deal if unit economics meet target.
Quotes from call: 'Latency matters for our agent-first UX — p95 needs to be predictable', 'If Dedicated halves cost per 1M tokens we can commit', paraphrased from Head of Product (Anika Bhatia).

Next technical steps: 3/08 sizing deep-dive with infra + SE (Carlos + Redwood infra lead), produce final Dedicated cluster config + explicit QPS->GPU mapping. Security team to run on-site checklist; expected completion 3/12. Procurement to prepare PO draft after sizing.
Open items: exact failover policy between Hosted and Dedicated during outages, SSO test plan, final benchmarking run on production-ish workload (longer tail tokens to validate p95).

Internal notes (sales): prioritize getting a small committed Dedicated pilot (3-month) to prove cost and latency before full 12-month commit. Prep A/B test plan for canary rollout and rollback policies.
Customer contact list: Anika Bhatia (Head of Product), Leo Park (Platform Eng), Margo Ruiz (Security). AE/SE touchpoints: Maya Chen (AE), Carlos Vega (SE), Priya Nair (CSM).
History summary: moved from discovery -> demo (2/18) -> Hosted trial (2/1–ongoing) -> evaluation (current). Strong signal to convert to Dedicated if sizing + pricing align.
